known.title: Decision 2 says that the contract's Yolo runs table already gives the tdd-workflow user escalation to the manager, but the contract has no such row
known.summary: Decision 2 uses the claim that the contract's Yolo runs table already gives the manager the user escalation that tdd-workflow asks for, and from it lets the Verification Results record replace that escalation. At repo_ref, the Yolo runs table in plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/plan-manager/references/plan-contract.md (lines 374-383) has rows only for path and Mode, an existing plan or incomplete request, a non-local Effect, linked-branch timing, a dirty checkout, review-loop continuation, a plan-review blocked verdict, and public disclosure. No row covers a wrong spec test or a tdd-workflow escalation, and line 372 keeps all other contract rules in force. No file under plugins/plan-lifecycle names that escalation (git grep -n -i escalat at repo_ref finds nothing). The real support is in the yolo skill (plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/yolo/SKILL.md, lines 14-16 and 31-34: the invocation answers every routine lifecycle question, and no ask comes before the merge question). So the premise of the decision is false. The plan adds no such row (step 2 changes only the advice phrase), and yolo text written from this decision points to a contract rule that does not exist.

known.title: Step 2 leaves plan-manager/SKILL.md out of its Files cell, but the content-hash refresh that the step requires writes that file
known.locator: Steps, row 2 contract_advice (line 31); Research, repository facts, content-hash item (line 17)
known.summary: Step 2 edits plan-contract.md, a reference file of the plan-manager skill, and its Done when requires 'content hash refreshed'. At repo_ref, scripts/skills/content-hash.mjs (hashSkill, lines 73-88) hashes SKILL.md together with every references/*.md file of the skill. So the contract edit changes the plan-manager hash, and the backfill that plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/AGENTS.md requires (lines 23-32) rewrites content_hash and metadata.updated in plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/plan-manager/SKILL.md (lines 7-8). The plugin gate checks this with content-hash.mjs --check-only (scripts/ci.mjs, line 570). A run of content-hash.mjs on a copy of the skill gave bb1ee37a (equal to the stored hash) at repo_ref and be9d0c59 after the merged contract edit. Research line 17 also names plan-manager/SKILL.md as a backfill target. The plan contract (plan-contract.md, lines 69-71) makes Files the scope of the step, so step 2 writes a file outside its scope, and scope and shared-path checks miss that file.

known.title: Acceptance A4 greps for a phrase that the advice paragraph already holds, so it passes when step 2 is not done
known.summary: A4 runs grep -n "Research section that" on plan-contract.md and expects one line in the advice paragraph. At repo_ref, plan-contract.md line 235 already reads 'paths, a Research section that holds only `_Not researched yet._` after drafting,', and it is the only match (git grep -n "Research section that" at repo_ref prints line 235 only). After the change (merge commit c1d413a0e86e45d01fd12dee62977baac9ffb7c2) the same grep also prints one line, line 235. So A4 gives the same result with and without step 2, and no Acceptance row checks that the advice paragraph names an empty Research section, which is the phrase 'is empty or holds only' that decision 3 asks for.

known.title: Decision 1 moves the temporary check worktree into the docks-review scratch directory, against the root AGENTS.md worktree rule and the Commits item 2 text that it edits
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 1 (line 21); Steps, row 1 yolo_text (line 30)
known.summary: Decision 1 sets <path> in yolo Commits item 2 to $(git rev-parse --git-path docks-review)/check-<short-sha>. At repo_ref, the root AGENTS.md (Tool-agnostic rules, line 104) says that agent scratch worktrees live under $XDG_DATA_HOME/agent-worktrees/<repo>/<slug>, and line 105 keeps the docks-review directory for review bundles and plan-body exports. git rev-parse --git-path docks-review resolves inside the git directory: .git/docks-review in a plain clone and .git/worktrees/<id>/docks-review in a linked worktree (checked in both; AGENTS.md line 105 says the same). The same Commits item 2 says 'Do not put it under /tmp or inside .git' (plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/yolo/SKILL.md, lines 213-214), and the contract puts the yolo worktree under agent-worktrees (plan-contract.md, lines 421-422). So step 1 would ship a yolo rule that breaks the repository instruction and contradicts the next sentence of the same item.
